rows.en: Sheryl, got a sec?
Oh, do you need something from me, \p?

White Day...?
Oh, the day you give something back for Valentine's.
You actually remembered? Not bad at all.
Just knowing you remembered makes me plenty happy.

I'll be counting on you from here on too,
\p.
Same here.
rows.notes: x3: also scd_com_712 (male) and scd_fes_201 (male); "Same here." answers a yoroshiku in any of them.

rows.en:
(I managed to give her the return gift, and Sheryl
seemed happy too, so I guess it went well.)

(Sorry, Sheryl, but it's just too embarrassing.
I can't bring myself to give her the return gift...)

(Today's White Day. I bought a return gift
for Klan-senpai, but now that I actually
have to give it to her, I'm getting nervous...)
Give Klan-senpai the return gift
Don't give Klan-senpai the return gift
Klan-senpai, do you have a moment?

Ooh... Now that you mention it, today is White Day.
You remembered? How very commendable of you!

Just knowing you remembered
is quite enough to make me happy.

I'm counting on you from here on too,
\p.

Same here, I'm counting on you too,
Klan-senpai.

(I managed to give her the return gift,
and Klan-senpai seemed happy too,
so I guess it went well.)

(Sorry, Klan-senpai, but it's just too embarrassing.
I can't bring myself to give her the return gift...)

(So today's the graduation ceremony.
Klan-senpai and Claire-senpai...
They're graduating from Mihoshi today, huh.)
Waaah, Claire-senpaaai!!

Come on, Yuu, don't cry.
It's not like we'll never see each other again, okay?
But~
I'll still drop by every now and then... okay?
Senpaaaaaai!!!
(Akimizu really does love Claire-senpai, huh.)

So today I graduate from Mihoshi as well...
This school building has looked after me
for three years...
What're you getting all teary-eyed for, Klan?
Hmph! I am NOT getting teary-eyed!

Still, Klan graduating from Mihoshi today, huh...
You sure don't look like someone who's about
to be a college student.
rows.notes: Klan is going on to university (daigakusei): "college student".

rows.en:
You're treating me like a child again!
Pretty cheeky for someone who used to cry
whenever I wasn't around!
Sheesh, don't drag up stuff from when we were kids.

...Geez, and here I was, ready to give you
a normal congratulations for once...
Congrats on graduating, Klan...
Y-yes... Thank you, Michel.
(Those two are as close as ever, too.)

Come to think of it, \p-kun,
aren't you going to be sad that I'm graduating?
Huh?! N-no, I'm really, really sad...

Hmph! After all the looking after I've done for you,
I don't get a single word of thanks?
I-I'm really grateful to you, Klan-senpai!
So no word of thanks for me in particular, then...
O-of course I'm grateful to you too, Claire-senpai!!
Hahahahaha!
(Huh? Were they just teasing me?)

You truly are an amusing one.
I may be graduating from Mihoshi, but I'm still
counting on you from here on.
Same goes for me.

Yes!
And please keep looking out for me, too!
rows.notes: Boku no hou koso yoroshiku: player answering Klan and Claire.

rows.en:
(Klan-senpai, Claire-senpai...
Congratulations on your graduation!)
(Come visit Mihoshi every now and then, okay?)

(So today's the graduation ceremony.
Klan-senpai and Claire-senpai...
They're graduating from Mihoshi today, aren't they.)
(Yuu really does love Claire-senpai, doesn't she.)
(Those two are as close as ever, too.)

Come to think of it, \p-chan,
aren't you going to be sad that I'm graduating?
(Huh? Were they just teasing me?)

Yes!
And please keep looking out for me, too!

All right, that's it for today's class!
Everyone, fall in!

(Phew~ I know it's the last class of the school year,
but you're going way too hard on us,
Hilda-sensei...)
rows.notes: Konnendo saigo no jugyou: "last class of the school year", right before summer break; consistent with scd_com_527, where the player becomes a second-year after the break.

rows.en:
Now then, the summer break you've all no doubt
been looking forward to starts next week.

While Mihoshi Academy is on summer break,
I'll keep the training rooms and such open
so you can train whenever you like.

Train on your own, study on your own...
Use them however you see fit!

(Training on my own, huh... I'd like to take it
easy at least over summer break, though...)

How you spend your summer break
is up to you.

...But anyone who slacks off had better be ready
to cry the moment the new term starts!
(...I'm gonna work hard and train on my own!)
There's one last thing I want to say...

Enjoy your summer break to the fullest!!
That's all! Dismissed!

(Summer break starts next week...
Like Hilda-sensei said, if I don't train on my own,
I'll probably go through hell once break is over...)

(But it's summer break, after all, so I've gotta
have plenty of fun and enjoy it to the fullest!)

(Phew~ I know it's the last class of the school year,
but you're going way too hard on us,
Hilda-sensei...)
(...I'm gonna work hard and train on my own!)

(Summer break starts next week...
Like Hilda-sensei said, if I don't train on my own,
I'll probably go through hell once break is over...)

(But it's summer break, after all, so I've gotta
have plenty of fun and enjoy it to the fullest!)

uncertain: c22209/c22210 and the other White Day choices: okaeshi rendered 'return gift'; slice 307 (Nanase/Ranka choices) is another agent's, worth harmonising.
